# Site for sale

> Lakeview Hill, Site 14, Barnacranny, Bushypark, Galway A rare opportunity to acquire a serviced site with full planning permission in one of Bushypark's most sought-after settings. Site 14 extends to c. 0.232ha (0.57 acres) and comes with full planning permission (Ref. 21/161) for a striking contemporary six-bedroom residence of approximately 418 sq.m (4,500 sq.ft) over two floors.
